messages:
marta: Heads up — we're deploying audit schema v2 for customer-facing events tomorrow. Need sign-off on webhook and S3/SIEM validation steps before rollout.

devon: Do we have a concise diff of v1 -> v2? I want to confirm Splunk and Datadog mappings won't break dashboards.

marta: Main changes: normalized actor.id, added resource.hierarchy (array), explicit kms_key_id on storage exports, and event.outcome enum. Also tightened timestamp to iso8601+ms.

shaun: For customers using webhook delivery, we should add an HMAC header and a replay window; also send a sample set they can run against.

eli: Agreed. Propose validating via two paths: 1) schema conformance (jsonschema) 2) semantic checks (e.g., resource.hierarchy length, kms_key_id format). I'll draft a checklist.

marta: Draft checklist would be great. Also need to decide whether to send both v1 and v2 events during a short migration window or provide a replay API. Thoughts?

devon: Migration window with dual-write is messy for internal consumers. Replay API is safer for customers: they can fetch historical events after we switch. Ops team can handle retention.

ops-ci: ops follow-up: S3 export will now include kms_key_id metadata. Need to confirm KMS permissions for integrations team. Who owns the kms rotation policy?

marta: Security owns rotation policy but we'll coordinate with infra. For onboarding, customers with Private deployments will supply KMS ARNs; hosted customers will have our managed key — we need to document key identifiers in the onboarding checklist.

security-bot: vuln-triage reminder: CVE-2025-XXXX affects older audit exporter that didn't validate event size. Please confirm v2 enforces payload size limits.

eli: Added payload.max_bytes = 1_048_576 to the schema (1MB). Also added top-level event.signature (optional) for customers who want signed events.

marta: Here's a compact sample webhook event we'll give customers for validation: 

```
{
  "event_type": "model.deploy",
  "timestamp": "2025-03-14T18:23:45.123Z",
  "actor": {"id": "team:infra:alice", "type": "user"},
  "resource": {"id": "model:redwood/llm-3b", "hierarchy": ["account:1234","project:search"]},
  "outcome": "success",
  "delivery": {"method": "webhook", "signature": "sha256=..."},
  "storage": {"s3_path": "s3://audit-exports/acct-1234/2025-03-14.json.gz", "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-..."}
}
```

shaun: Nice. For Splunk/Datadog mapping, we should publish a sample mapping file and guidance: which field maps to host/source/sourcetype. I'll take that on.

devon: Validation tests: we should provide a small CLI for customers to POST sample events to their webhook endpoint with retries + HMAC header generation. That'll reduce onboarding friction.

eli: I'll make the CLI and a jsonschema file. Also adding a postman collection for customers who prefer GUI.

marta: On the rollout plan: 1) publish schema and examples to docs, 2) open beta with 3 pilot customers (webhook + S3), 3) gather any SIEM mapping issues, 4) cutover and enable replay API for 30 days. Ops, can you confirm S3 bucket lifecycle and KMS access?

ops-ci: Confirmed: buckets will be versioned and encrypted; lifecycle 90 days by default for beta, KMS policy will allow redwood-infra and customer-kms roles. We'll run a dry export to staging.

security-bot: Incident response note: ensure audit-ingest pipeline tags events with producer_version so we can trace issues back to schema. Also add monitoring alert if >1% of events fail schema validation.

marta: Good call. We'll add producer_version and validation-rate alert. Last Q: do we want to keep event names identical, or prefix with v2?

shaun: Keep names same, add schema_version: "v2". Easier for dashboards and filters.

devon: I'll update internal consumers and libs to accept schema_version; we'll log a deprecation banner for v1 for 60 days.

marta: OK — action items: eli (CLI + schema json), shaun (SIEM mapping docs), devon (internal consumer bump + deprecation), ops-ci (staging export + KMS policy), security-bot (monitoring rule). I'll tag owners in the rollout doc and schedule pilot runs. :thumbsup:

eli: Starting on schema and CLI today, will share PR by EOD.

shaun: Mapping draft by tomorrow morning.

devon: Will coordinate consumer updates and publish deprecation timeline.

marta: Thanks all. If anyone finds edge cases (e.g., exceptionally long resource hierarchies, non-ARN KMS ids), add to the rollout issue.

(ends)
